finding.summary: The relaxed `list` paragraph-interrupt also fires for lone `*` and `+` at top level, changing paragraph rendering for markdown `lheading` never touched
finding.evidence:
`isEmptyBulletLine` accepts all three bullet markers (`list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts:39`: `if (marker !== DASH && marker !== 0x2a /* * */ && marker !== 0x2b /* + */)`), and the wrapper's early `return true` at list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts:190 fires whenever `silent && state.parentType === 'paragraph'`, with the only positional constraint being `state.sCount[line] >= state.blkIndent` (:32) — which is trivially satisfied at top level where `blkIndent === 0`. So the change is not confined to the `#517` nested-dash shape: paragraph text such as `see below *` or `note +`, which upstream markdown-it renders as lazy continuation inside the `

`, now terminates the paragraph and emits a stray empty `

`. Nothing in the diff's `- 1 -` framing, the design note, or the five added tests exercises a `*`/`+` marker or a top-level (unindented) empty bullet, so this consumer-visible behaviour change to arbitrary existing note bodies was not considered. Fix belongs on the new code: either restrict `isEmptyBulletLine` to the dash marker that `lheading` actually contends for, or require an enclosing list context.

decision.reason: I could not verify or refute this finding because the code under review is not present in my working directory. The checkout at /tmp/eval-repo-cache/d7fea222a81170524e3e74bd41ac633ba21dfe95 contains only 43 files of agent/CI tooling (agent/*.mjs, agent/lenses/*.md, hooks/*.sh, verify-*.mjs), as recorded in .materialized. Glob '**/*.ts' returns nothing; Glob '**/list-empty-bullet-plugin*' and '**/notes*' return nothing; Grep for 'isEmptyBulletLine|blkIndent|lheading' and for 'markdown-it|notes' return no matches. The three source files named in the authoritative changed-file list (packages/notes/src/view/list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts, preview.ts, preview.test.ts) are all absent, so I cannot read the quoted lines (:32, :39, :190) nor Grep for downstream consumers of the markdown pipeline that the blast-radius question turns on. This absence is an artifact of an incomplete checkout, not evidence the code differs from the reviewer's description, so 'not-present' would be an unfounded refutation ground; 'pre-existing' is also unavailable since the changed-file list names list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts as modified by this PR. The claim as stated is in-lane for blast radius: a relaxed paragraph-interrupt in a shared markdown renderer would change rendering of pre-existing note bodies containing a lone '*' or '+' continuation line, which is a behaviour change to consumers outside the diff. Unable to confirm the bypass concretely, but per the rule that uncertainty keeps the finding, I confirm rather than drop it from the merge gate.
